lastCompletedStory.title: Unit tests for end-state prune classification and coalesced narration

nextStoryContext: US-004 adds two changes to test/release/merge-watch.test.ts: (1) updates the '(US-001) branchPruned fields...' test Part 1 to use the coalesced-single-line contract: exactly one notification line must contain both the tag ('v1.2.3') and the prune sub-status ('prune'), and there must be no standalone warn line (a separate line with 'warn'+'prune' but without the tag); (2) adds a new '(US-004/AC5)' test that uses makeSeqPollFn([MERGED]) and a custom postMergeFn returning branchPrunedLocal:false to assert that notifications.filter(n => n.includes('v1.2.3') && n.includes('prune')).toHaveLength(1). AC1-4 were already fully covered by existing tests added in US-001/US-002 (post-merge.test.ts). All 2287 tests pass, typecheck clean, check:all exits 0. All four stories in the PRD now pass.
